stories.title: Trump voegt daad bij het woord: Eerste journalisten geweerd uit Witte Huis

en.title: Trump follows through: First journalists barred from White House
en.summary: President Trump has denied access to the White House for journalists from CNN, MS NOW, and Politico, following his Friday announcement that these outlets would no longer be welcome.

stories.title: NAVO verwelkomt Groenland-deal met VS, Denen benadrukken behoud soevereiniteit

en.title: NATO welcomes Greenland deal with US, Denmark emphasizes sovereignty retention
en.summary: NATO responded positively to a Greenland agreement involving the United States, Denmark, and Greenland. Denmark and Greenland stated the deal preserves Greenlandic sovereignty despite Trump's assertion that Washington would gain permanent control over the island's security.

stories.title: Denemarken en VS blijven vaag over Groenland-deal, NAVO is tevreden

en.title: Denmark and US remain vague about Greenland deal, NATO is satisfied
en.summary: The United States, Denmark, and Greenland have disclosed limited details about their agreement on Greenland, which is scheduled for signing next week. The specific terms of the arrangement remain undisclosed.

stories.title: Rust teruggekeerd in centrum Den Haag na geweld van extreemrechtse betogers

en.title: Order returns to The Hague city center after far-right protester violence
en.summary: Police reported that The Hague's city center has returned to calm following a Saturday afternoon incident where far-right protesters threw fireworks during a 'We are the people' demonstration on the Malieveld.

stories.title: In beeld | Veel publiek bij herdenking Operatie Market Garden in Ede

en.title: In focus | Large crowds at Operation Market Garden commemoration in Ede
en.summary: Over 60,000 people attended a Saturday commemoration of the 1944 Airborne landings and Operation Market Garden near Ede, where hundreds of paratroopers reenacted the historical airborne operation. World War II veterans were also present at the event.

stories.title: Jongen raakt gewond na val van rijdende trein bij Uitgeest

en.title: Boy injured after falling from moving train near Uitgeest
en.summary: A boy was injured after falling from a moving train between Uitgeest and Krommenie early morning. According to police, he had been holding onto the outside of the train after missing his boarding.

stories.title: Jongen gewond na val van rijdende trein bij Uitgeest: 'Levensgevaarlijk'

en.title: Boy injured after falling from moving train near Uitgeest: 'Life-threatening'
en.summary: A boy sustained injuries after falling from a moving train at high speed near Uitgeest.

stories.title: Extreemrechtse demonstranten gebruiken geweld op Malieveld, ME drijft betogers uiteen

en.title: Far-right demonstrators use violence on Malieveld, riot police disperse protesters
en.summary: Far-right demonstrators engaged in violent behavior at a Malieveld protest, prompting riot police to disperse the gathering.

stories.title: ME beëindigt extreemrechtse betoging Malieveld, Van Weel noemt geweld 'walgelijk'

en.title: Police end far-right protest at Malieveld, Van Weel calls violence 'disgusting'
en.summary: Dutch police dissolved a far-right demonstration in The Hague on Saturday due to ongoing violence. Protesters were escorted from the area and an emergency order was issued allowing authorities to remove people contributing to disorder.

stories.title: Extreemrechtse betoging op Malieveld ontbonden na geweld tegen ME, noodbevel van kracht

en.title: Far-right protest at Malieveld dissolved after violence against police, emergency order in effect
en.summary: Police intervened at a far-right demonstration in The Hague when protesters became violent and threw fireworks. The gathering was officially dissolved in the afternoon and an emergency order was implemented.

stories.title: Advies Clingendael: niet voor drie, maar voor acht dagen eten in huis

en.title: Clingendael Advice: Store Eight Days of Food, Not Three
en.summary: The Clingendael Institute recommends Dutch households increase their food stockpiles due to concerns about the nation's vulnerability in food distribution and production systems.

stories.title: CNN, Politico en MS NOW volgens Trump ‘per direct’ uit Witte Huis verbannen, maar gevolgen nog onduidelijk

en.title: CNN, Politico and MSNOW banned from White House by Trump 'immediately', but consequences unclear
en.summary: Trump announced an immediate ban on three news outlets from White House access, though further details about implementation remain unclear.
